listing.name: Lightshow
listing.summary: Changes the visual appearance of vanilla beams to color-code them by damage type instead of aesthetic choices.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the visual appearance of vanilla beams to color-code them by damage type instead of aesthetic choices.

description:
Download

NexusMods mirror

Ever died to a High Intensity Laser beam that looked just like a much tamer Graviton Beam? Ever got all your weapons disabled because the Ion Beam also look like it? Didn't liked that? Well this is a pretty straightforward utility mini-mod that changes the look of all vanilla beams to better differentiate them. They are now color coded for their damage type rather than for aesthetic choices. They might seem odd at first, but it will make your life in the sector slightly easier.

If some of the new colors aren't to your tastes, you can go in the mod's data/weapons folder and simply delete the weapons you want to keep unchanged.

aiDescription: Changes the visual appearance of all vanilla beams to color-code them by damage type, improving differentiation during combat. This helps players quickly identify weapon types, such as High Intensity Lasers, Graviton Beams, and Ion Beams, which previously looked similar. Users can customize the effect by removing specific weapon files in the mod's data folder. The change is designed to make combat clearer and reduce confusion in high-pressure situations.
